Quick update from the eval bench (short):

What we ran:
- 48-hour run against the CloudWave sample (n=12k requests, seq len median 420, peak concurrency ~18)
- Two configurations: quantized fp16 with KV cache, and standard fp32 without cache.

Results (high level):
- p50/p95/p99 latencies (quantized): 35ms / 110ms / 220ms
- p50/p95/p99 latencies (fp32): 48ms / 170ms / 340ms
- Cost delta (quantized vs fp32): ~28% lower token cost on our test harness
- Observations: short tails correlate with bursts in concurrent requests — recommend continuous batching + prefix caching in prod for predictability.

Action items from my side:
- Deliver full perf CSV and a short README with test harness config: due Fri, Jul 27 (link will be posted).
- Proposal: enable KV caching + burst autoscale during pilot to reduce p99 variance — will include config snippet in README.

Notes for CloudWave: these numbers are based on the sample dataset; we'll schedule a 30-minute joint test if you want to run it from your environment (low-friction way to confirm).

-Mon
Monica Patel
Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: usage_test_results_Jul24.csv (CSV stub)
